n = 11

# Create variables
X = [[z3.Int(f"x_{i}_{j}") for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]

s = z3.Solver()

# Domain constraints and clues
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        s.add(X[i][j] >= 0, X[i][j] <= 10)
        if clues[i*n + j] != -1:
            s.add(X[i][j] == clues[i*n + j])

# Row and column distinctness
for i in range(n):
    s.add(z3.Distinct([X[i][j] for j in range(n)]))
for j in range(n):
    s.add(z3.Distinct([X[i][j] for i in range(n)]))

print("Solving...")
res = s.check()
print("Result:", res)
if res == z3.sat:
    m = s.model()
    sol = []
    for i in range(n):
        row = []
        for j in range(n):
            val = m.evaluate(X[i][j]).as_long()
            row.append(val)
        sol.extend(row)
        print(row)
    print("Flat solution:")
    print(sol)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
